description:
Acıbadem University is a thematic university in the field of health sciences, founded in 2007 by the Acibadem Health and Education Foundation. The university, which carries the Acibadem culture, which is formed with 25 years of experience and knowledge in health services, to higher education; With its strong academic staff and advanced technological infrastructure, it trains well-equipped health professionals who are open to continuous development.

With its Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design Certificate Kerem Aydınlar Campus on the Anatolian side of Istanbul, with an indoor area of ​​100,000 square meters, Acibadem University makes a difference with its academic and social facilities.

The university campus has been designed to provide comprehensive education to students in the field of health sciences. It also hosts many clubs created for students to spend time, have fun and improve themselves.

Acibadem University offers an environment that will make future health professionals interested in life and health sciences and who want to improve themselves happy in every respect.

The Clinical Simulation and Advanced Endoscopic - Robotic Surgery Training Center within the university are one of the most comprehensive medical training centers in the world with all its departments and technological infrastructure. The Center has the "Center of Excellence Certificate" given by the Surgical Training Center Academy, which only two medical training centers in the world have. Accredited by the Network of Accredited Clinical Skills Centers of Europe and the Society for Simulation in Healthcare, the center provides pre-and post-graduate training.
